text: Mara pulls the compliance team's own audit charter and checklist. It instructs exporting group membership, de-duplicating, and counting. Nowhere does it instruct checking direct Entra ID role or AWS IAM policy assignments.

That distinction matters: a data error means someone made a mistake within a correct method. A methodology gap means the method itself, followed perfectly, is structurally incapable of seeing a category of access that exists.

Neither tool is at fault. The audit team followed their checklist exactly. Mara's automation was deliberately built, back in Lessons 8 and 9, to check more. The gap is between what one process was scoped to check and what this segment's sensitivity requires.

The conclusion: the audit's group-membership-only method is structurally unable to detect direct assignment -- exactly how 5 stale break-glass grants went undercounted for fourteen months. Not a bug. Not an error. A scope gap.
